_about: Graph portrait knobs. The framework ships this file; a vault overrides any subset in state/portrait_targets.json (same shape, validated on load). `lifehug doctor` prints every effective value and where it came from. Keys starting with _ are comments.

drawing._about: Pixel radii in the graph view. A node's fill radius is radius_min + percentile * radius_span; a node that is not ranked draws at radius_min.

credit._about: How a source's telling is shared among the entity pages that cite it. split: equal = an answer on n pages gives 1/n to each (owner ruling, 2026-09-29); whole = 1 to each. source_prefixes: which vault-relative source paths earn credit.

ranking._about: Peer percentile within a type (graph-vis D5). A type with one member has no peers to rank against; zero credit is not a rank.
